title: Syrian Eggplant Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic tagine made with juicy eggplant, charred vegetables, and a blend of Middle Eastern spices.

ingredients.name: cumin
ingredients.notes: Ground and adds a warm flavor

ingredients.name: coriander
ingredients.notes: Ground and adds a citrusy flavor

ingredients.name: paprika
ingredients.notes: Smoked paprika adds a deep flavor

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.notes: Freshly ground and used to finish

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until caramelized, about 10 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the eggplant, bell pepper, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggplant is tender.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
